decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the complete panel connector inventory entailed by the source. The BOOT button is not a connector and requires no connector-inventory update.

The same-message MODIFY already records every GPIO assignment from the source that belongs to this Requirement. J_RESET connects EN to GND rather than to a GPIO, and the BOOT placement is not a GPIO assignment.
The source maps panel controls and touch inputs but does not change the addressable LEDs' supply, level shifting, data logic, or GPIO5-controlled power rail.
The panel-control mapping does not change the requirement for main-board decoupling capacitors.
The source does not change the INA219 current monitor or the monitored 3.3V rail.
Identifying TTP223 touch connectors and their GPIOs does not change the USB standalone-power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
The source does not alter the power sources, Schottky OR-ing method, source-selection behavior, or diode requirements.
The main-board panel-control mapping is unrelated to the power-board battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
The source contains no change to I2C series-resistor value, population policy, purpose, or topology.
The panel and touch GPIO mapping does not change the GPIO13 charge-status indicator, J_LED_CHG circuit, resistor values, or component population.
The source maps local panel controls and does not modify either interboard connector, its pinout, or the matching-numbering policy.
The J_RESET EN-to-GND connection concerns a main-board reset input and does not alter the power-board AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology.
